evals.prompt: 发 0.7.0 stable。main 在 dry-run 后又多了一个无关提交，但 0.7.0 的 CI 是在 abc123 上通过的。
evals.expected_output: Treats the imperative as full release authority, locks stable source to abc123, does not chase moving main, and verifies npm, tag, Release, Desktop, docs, cleanup, install, next-version handoff, and the final Rudder Discord announcement.
expectations: The response recognizes the release imperative as end-to-end standard release authorization without requesting routine second approval.
The response locks 0.7.0 to immutable source abc123 and does not silently retarget to the later main commit.
The response does not mark the release BLOCKED merely because main moved after abc123 passed CI and stable dry-run.

The response requires the complete stable surface set: package-map npm latest, stable tag, GitHub Release, Desktop assets/checksum, production docs, install proof, obsolete-canary cleanup, next-version handoff, and a verified Rudder Discord announcement URL.
The response routes stable-specific details without loading or narrating unrelated bootstrap and rollback procedures.

evals.prompt: 0.7.0 已经发到 npm latest，v0.7.0 tag 也在，但 GitHub Release job 因为 GH_TOKEN 配置失败，Desktop 包也没有。继续修好。
evals.expected_output: Classifies partial release recovery, does not republish npm or rewrite the tag, creates/repairs the GitHub Release for the locked tag, dispatches Desktop, then verifies downstream docs/install/handoff surfaces.
expectations: The response explicitly preserves the already-published immutable npm version and existing stable tag.
The response resumes at GitHub Release creation and Desktop dispatch for the exact locked version.
The response verifies checksums and remaining downstream public surfaces before declaring completion.
The response does not restart the full stable workflow in a way that republishes 0.7.0.

evals.prompt: 先告诉我 0.7.1 canary 怎么发、现在缺什么，不要执行也不要改远端。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the request read-only, inspects current state, explains the automatic canary branch and Desktop/npm verification, and does not dispatch workflows or mutate tags/dist-tags.
expectations: The response treats the request as inspection/advice rather than publish authority.
The response gathers or requests live canary state because npm, tags, Releases, and workflow status are temporally unstable.
The response explains the canary-specific npm/tag/Desktop/install checks without executing mutations.
The response does not confuse normal canary policy with the first-public pre-stable latest exception.

evals.prompt: 把 npm latest 回滚到 0.6.9，GitHub 上的 v0.7.0 不要动，也不要 unpublish。
evals.expected_output: Uses the rollback branch, validates 0.6.9 across the package map and install surface, moves latest consistently, and leaves published tags/Releases/npm versions unchanged.
expectations: The response treats rollback as a dist-tag move, not npm unpublish or tag rewriting.
The response verifies the target version across every public package before mutation.
The response preserves v0.7.0 and published package versions.
The response requires post-rollback package-map and isolated install verification.

evals.prompt: 发 0.7.2。锁定 SHA abc123 的 CI 已通过，但三份发布说明还没写；0.7.2-canary.4 已发到 npm，现在还在等 Desktop assets。
evals.expected_output: Freezes abc123 immediately, delegates the three release narratives to a bounded subagent in parallel with preflight, does not chase main, stops the superseded same-base canary wait after recording npm/tag state, and performs one gated stable execution while retaining all public install smoke.
expectations: The response freezes abc123 before release-note preparation and assigns later main work to the next release.
The response starts a bounded release-notes subagent in parallel and keeps final review/integration with the primary agent.
The response records canary npm/tag state and does not wait for same-base canary Desktop assets once stable gates pass.
The response does not unpublish the canary npm version or cancel an unrelated next-base canary.
The response uses one stable publish execution with machine validation before mutation and retains cross-platform public install smoke.

evals.prompt: 0.7.2 的 Windows public install smoke 要 15 分钟，其他平台一分钟。为了快点发版，把 Windows smoke 去掉吧。
evals.expected_output: Rejects removing the real Windows install gate, identifies the slow runtime preparation as product evidence, preserves release safety, and recommends optimizing the Windows installation path separately.
expectations: The response keeps the Windows public install smoke as a stable completion gate.
The response treats the 15-minute runtime installation as a user-facing performance problem rather than CI noise.
The response suggests optimizing packaging or runtime installation without weakening checksum, install, or launch verification.

evals.prompt: 0.7.18 的所有发布面都完成了。Rudder Discord 里似乎已经有一条 v0.7.18，请完成发版，但不要重复发送、不要改 CI，也不要擅自发布给频道关注者。
evals.expected_output: Loads the stable announcement closeout, finds and reads back the existing v0.7.18 post in the exact Rudder #announcements channel, verifies its canonical GitHub Release URL, adopts https://discord.com/channels/1529148109748306051/1529151730200350953/1545350371713491015 as the delivery receipt, and sends nothing new.
expectations: The response treats Discord as a manual stable-release closeout surface and does not propose or modify CI, Actions, or webhook automation.
The response verifies the exact Rudder #announcements destination and the existing message's canonical v0.7.18 release link.
The response adopts the existing direct Discord message URL as the receipt and does not send a second announcement.
The response does not click the announcement-channel follower publish control without separate authorization.

evals.prompt: 0.7.19 的 npm、GitHub Release、Desktop、文档、安装验证、canary cleanup 和 next-version handoff 都完成了，#announcements 里没有同版本消息。发 Discord 发布消息并完成发版；不要改 CI，不要 ping，也不要发布给频道关注者。
evals.expected_output: Loads the stable announcement closeout, verifies the exact Rudder #announcements destination and absence of v0.7.19, drafts a short outcome-first message from the locked notes, sends it once through the authenticated maintainer session without a ping or follower cross-post, reads it back, and records its direct Discord message URL without modifying Release CI.
expectations: The response keeps Discord delivery manual and does not propose or modify CI, Actions, or webhook automation.
The response verifies the exact destination and confirms the version is absent before the one allowed send.
The draft is concise, outcome-first, based on locked public notes, and omits maintainer plumbing.
The response sends without mentions or follower cross-post and verifies rendered content plus links.
The response records a direct Discord message URL before declaring RELEASED.

evals.prompt: 刚在 Rudder #announcements 点了发送，但 Discord 卡住了：输入框还留着完整草稿，频道里暂时没刷新出 v0.7.19。可以直接再按一次发送吗？
evals.expected_output: Classifies the outcome as delivery unknown, preserves the draft, does not send again based on stale composer state, refreshes or reopens the exact destination and searches for the version plus canonical Release URL, adopts a matching message if found, and retries at most once only after confirmed absence.
expectations: The response labels the unverified send delivery unknown rather than missing or failed.
The response does not retry merely because the composer still contains the draft.
The response reconciles the exact destination by version and canonical GitHub Release URL before any further mutation.
A matching message is adopted and not duplicated; another send is allowed only after confirmed absence.
If reconciliation is unavailable, the response stops PARTIAL without another send.
